title: Black Cell Capacity in Catalan polyominoes
summary: A Catalan word is a sequence $w_1w_2\cdots w_n$ of nonnegative integers such that $w_1=0$ and $w_{i}\leq w_{i-1}+1$ for $2\leq i\leq n$. Given a Catalan word, we construct a column-convex polyomino (or \emph{bargraph}) by placing, at position $i$, a column of height $w_i + 1$, with all columns aligned along their bottom edges. On these Catalan polyominoes we define the black cell capacity by coloring the cells in a chessboard pattern and we count the number of black cells in the polyomino.
